title: Regional capitals: state or province and country

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?regionLabel ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?r) AS ?region) (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) WHERE { VALUES ?cls { wd:Q11828004 wd:Q5852411 wd:Q131541 wd:Q485258 wd:Q43233 wd:Q1221156 wd:Q1615742 wd:Q10864048 } ?r wdt:P31 ?cls ; wdt:P36 ?item ; wdt:P17 ?c . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?r wdt:P576 ?e } FILTER(?c != wd:Q30) } GROUP BY ?item HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?r) = 1) } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 264

region.pick: Of which state or province is {label} the capital?
region.match: Match each city to the state or province it is the capital of.
region.reverse: Which of these is the capital of {value}?

country.pick: In which country is {label}, the capital of {region}?
country.match: Match each regional capital to its country.
country.odd: Which of these is not a regional capital in {value}?
country.all: Which of these are regional capitals in {value}?

rows.label: Toronto
rows.description: capital and largest city of the province of Ontario, Canada
rows.hook: is home to the CN Tower and the country's biggest hockey shrine

rows.label: Melbourne
rows.description: capital city of Victoria, Australia
rows.hook: is known for its laneway coffee culture and hosts a major tennis Grand Slam every January

rows.label: Sydney
rows.description: capital city of New South Wales, Australia
rows.hook: is famous for a harbour with a sail-shaped opera house and a steel arch bridge

rows.label: Guangzhou
rows.description: capital city of Guangdong Province, China
rows.hook: is a huge southern port city once known to Westerners as Canton, famed for dim sum

rows.label: Munich
rows.description: capital and most populous city of Bavaria, Germany
rows.hook: hosts the world's biggest beer festival every autumn and is home to a famous football giant

rows.label: Perth
rows.description: capital city of Western Australia, Australia
rows.hook: is often called the most isolated major city on Earth, facing the Indian Ocean

rows.label: Halifax
rows.description: municipality in the province of Nova Scotia, Canada
rows.hook: is an Atlantic port whose harbour received bodies and survivors from a famous ocean liner sinking

rows.label: Brisbane
rows.description: capital city of Queensland, Australia
rows.hook: is a sunny river city just north of the Gold Coast, set to host a future Summer Olympics

rows.label: Magdeburg
rows.description: capital city of the German state of Saxony-Anhalt
rows.hook: is a river city on the Elbe that gave its name to a famous physics experiment with hemispheres

rows.label: Edmonton
rows.description: capital city of the province of Alberta, Canada
rows.hook: is home to one of the world's largest shopping malls and a hockey team once led by Wayne Gretzky

rows.label: Winnipeg
rows.description: capital and largest city of the province of Manitoba, Canada
rows.hook: sits where two rivers meet at the very middle of the continent and shares a name with a famous cartoon bear

rows.label: Quebec City
rows.description: capital city of the province of Quebec, Canada
rows.hook: is a walled, French-speaking city topped by a grand hotel that looks like a castle

rows.label: Chengdu
rows.description: capital of Sichuan Province, China
rows.hook: is the famously spicy-food capital and the home city of giant pandas

rows.label: Dresden
rows.description: capital city of the Free State of Saxony in Germany
rows.hook: was nicknamed Florence on the Elbe before its baroque center was flattened in a wartime bombing raid

rows.label: Adelaide
rows.description: capital city of South Australia
rows.hook: is a planned city known for its wine regions, festivals and lack of convict history

rows.label: Harbin
rows.description: capital of Heilongjiang province, China
rows.hook: is famous for its huge winter festival of ice and snow sculptures

rows.label: Hangzhou
rows.description: capital of Zhejiang Province, China
rows.hook: is a lakeside city beside the famous West Lake and home to a giant e-commerce company

rows.label: Nanjing
rows.description: capital city of Jiangsu Province, China, former capital of the Republic of China and China's Ming dynasty
rows.hook: is a former imperial capital with an ancient city wall and a memorial to a horrific wartime massacre

rows.label: Xi'an
rows.description: capital of Shaanxi Province, China
rows.hook: is the ancient starting point of the Silk Road and guardian of the Terracotta Army

rows.label: Victoria
rows.description: capital city of the province of British Columbia, Canada
rows.hook: is a mild-weather island city known for its Butchart Gardens and afternoon tea at a grand harbour hotel

rows.label: Stuttgart
rows.description: city on the Neckar river and capital of the federal state Baden-Württemberg, Germany
rows.hook: is the birthplace of two famous luxury car brands and their museums

rows.label: St. John's
rows.description: capital and largest city of the province of Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
rows.hook: is one of North America's oldest cities, with colorful row houses and a hill tied to early wireless

rows.label: Düsseldorf
rows.description: capital city of the German federated state of North Rhine-Westphalia
rows.hook: is a fashion and advertising hub with a long riverside promenade and a famous old-town beer, Altbier

rows.label: Hanover
rows.description: capital city of the German federated state of Lower Saxony
rows.hook: hosts the world's largest computer trade fair, CeBIT, and an enormous trade exhibition ground

rows.label: Wuhan
rows.description: capital city of Hubei Province, China
rows.hook: sits where the Yangtze meets the Han River and is where a global pandemic was first identified

rows.label: Regina
rows.description: capital and second-largest city of the province of Saskatchewan, Canada
rows.hook: is home to the training academy of the red-coated national police force

rows.label: Hobart
rows.description: capital city of Tasmania, Australia
rows.hook: is a harbour city below Mount Wellington, known for its Salamanca Market and a famous yacht race

rows.label: Shenyang
rows.description: Prefecture-level and sub-provincial city in Liaoning, China
rows.hook: is a northeastern industrial hub that holds an imperial palace of the last dynasty's early rulers

rows.label: Potsdam
rows.description: capital city of the German state of Brandenburg
rows.hook: is home to Sanssouci, the summer palace of Frederick the Great, and a famed Allied wartime conference

rows.label: Saarbrücken
rows.description: capital of the German state of Saarland
rows.hook: is a small city on the French border in the country's smallest area-state

rows.label: Manaus
rows.description: municipality of Amazonas state, Brazil
rows.hook: is a jungle metropolis on the Rio Negro with a grand opera house built from rubber wealth

rows.label: Belo Horizonte
rows.description: municipality of Minas Gerais state, Brazil
rows.hook: is a large inland city whose name means 'beautiful horizon' and hosted World Cup matches

rows.label: Mainz
rows.description: capital of the federal state Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
rows.hook: is the city where Johannes Gutenberg was born and lived, the inventor of the movable-type printing press

rows.label: Kunming
rows.description: capital of Yunnan province, China
rows.hook: is nicknamed the City of Eternal Spring for its mild climate

rows.label: Kiel
rows.description: German city, capital of Schleswig-Holstein
rows.hook: is a Baltic port city hosting a major annual sailing regatta called Week

rows.label: Salvador
rows.description: municipality of Bahia state, Brazil
rows.hook: is a coastal city of colorful colonial buildings and the heart of Afro-Brazilian culture

rows.label: Florianópolis
rows.description: municipality of Santa Catarina state, Brazil
rows.hook: is an island city of beaches and surfing, often nicknamed Magic Island

rows.label: Porto Alegre
rows.description: municipality of Rio Grande do Sul state, Brazil
rows.hook: is a southern city on the Guaíba lake known for its gaucho barbecue culture

rows.label: Zhengzhou
rows.description: capital of Henan province, China
rows.hook: is a central railway crossroads city close to the famed Shaolin Temple

rows.label: Changsha
rows.description: capital of Hunan province, China
rows.hook: is known for fiery cuisine, a riverside island and being an early home of Chairman Mao's youth

rows.label: Changchun
rows.description: capital city of Jilin Province, China
rows.hook: is a northeastern city known as the birthplace of its nation's auto industry

rows.label: Curitiba
rows.description: municipality of Paraná state, Brazil
rows.hook: is celebrated for its bus rapid transit system and green, planned urbanism

rows.label: Wiesbaden
rows.description: capital of the German state of Hesse
rows.hook: is a spa town famous for its hot springs and elegant casino

rows.label: Charlottetown
rows.description: capital city of the province of Prince Edward Island, Canada
rows.hook: is the birthplace of Confederation, host of the conference that led to a new nation

rows.label: Erfurt
rows.description: capital city of the German federal state of Thuringia
rows.hook: is a medieval city with a merchant-lined bridge and where Martin Luther studied

rows.label: Schwerin
rows.description: capital city of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Germany
rows.hook: is a city on a lake with a fairytale castle on an island

rows.label: Recife
rows.description: municipality of Pernambuco state, Brazil
rows.hook: is nicknamed the Venice of its nation for its many rivers and bridges

rows.label: Fuzhou
rows.description: capital city of Fujian province, China
rows.hook: is a city known as the Banyan city for its many old trees and is a port city of the Min River

rows.label: Fredericton
rows.description: capital city of the province of New Brunswick, Canada
rows.hook: is a quiet river city with a Gothic cathedral, and a university town on the Saint John River
